title: HackersJack: Major Revision and Reproducibility Kit
description: Data, analysis scripts, and outputs supporting a reproducible statistical analysis of pre- and post-assessment cybersecurity knowledge among Grade 5 and Grade 6 students participating in HackersJack, a cybersecurity education program. This archived release preserves the exact version of the materials used in the associated study.
